description: Blink and you’ll miss it! ⚡️It’s time for the SawStop hot dog test! We talk you through the @SawStop Europe technology that has already been in use for over 20 years in the US, explain how it works in practice, and of course do the hot dog test! 🌭 This is seriously impressive technology, and even better seen in person. So if you think a SawStop table saw is for you, we’re excited to be able to offer you demo at our Twickenham superstore! Just get in touch and we can arrange it with you 🙌  #sawstop #sawstoptablesaw #tablesaw #hotdogtest #woodworking #carpentry #construction #innovation #professional #safety #sawstophotdog
